records.name: PGIMER Chandigarh
records.description: Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) Chandigarh is one of India's premier medical institutions and a national referral center, established in 1962. It offers postgraduate and super-specialty medical programs across all disciplines of medicine, surgery, and allied health sciences. PGIMER is consistently ranked among India's top three medical institutions and is a major center for clinical research and medical innovation.

records.name: Maulana Azad Medical College
records.description: Maulana Azad Medical College (MAMC) New Delhi is one of India's most prestigious government medical colleges, affiliated with the University of Delhi and attached to Lok Nayak Hospital, one of Asia's largest public hospitals. It offers MBBS, MD, MS, and DM programs and is known for its high clinical exposure and research output. MAMC consistently ranks among the top government medical colleges in India and produces graduates who serve in leading medical institutions worldwide.

records.name: Grant Medical College Mumbai
records.description: Grant Medical College Mumbai, established in 1845, is one of the oldest and most prestigious medical institutions in Asia, affiliated with Maharashtra University of Health Sciences. It is attached to the historic Sir Jamshedjee Jejeebhoy (JJ) Group of Hospitals, providing vast clinical exposure to students. Grant Medical College offers MBBS and postgraduate programs and has a strong legacy of producing eminent physicians and surgeons.

records.name: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences
records.description: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS) in New Delhi is one of India's top government dental institutions, affiliated with the University of Delhi and co-located with Lok Nayak Hospital. It offers the BDS undergraduate program and MDS postgraduate programs across all major specialties of dentistry. MAIDS is known for its high patient volume, strong clinical training, and research contributions to oral health.

records.name: Government Dental College Mumbai
records.description: Government Dental College and Hospital Mumbai is one of the oldest dental colleges in India, established in 1938, and affiliated with Maharashtra University of Health Sciences. It offers BDS and MDS programs with strong clinical training at its attached hospital serving thousands of patients from across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The college has produced leading dental practitioners and academics who have shaped oral health education in India.

records.name: Manipal College of Dental Sciences
records.description: Manipal College of Dental Sciences (MCODS) is a top-ranked private dental institution under Manipal Academy of Higher Education, offering BDS and MDS programs across all dental specialties. It is recognized as a center of excellence in dental education, research, and patient care, and consistently ranks among India's top five dental colleges in NIRF. MCODS has pioneered dental simulation training and digital dentistry curricula in India.

records.name: SDM College of Dental Sciences
records.description: SDM College of Dental Sciences and Hospital in Dharwad is one of India's premier dental institutions, consistently ranked among the top dental colleges nationally. It offers BDS and MDS programs with exceptional infrastructure including the SDM Research Institute for Biomedical Sciences. SDM Dental College is known for its research output, community dental health programs, and adoption of advanced dental technologies.

records.name: Sports Authority of India (SAI)
records.description: Sports Authority of India (SAI) is the apex national sports body under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, responsible for training, development, and promotion of elite athletes through its network of national centers, academies, and training facilities across India. SAI manages national sports academies, coaches certification programs, and talent identification schemes like the Khelo India initiative. Its centers in Patiala, Bangalore, Kolkata, Gandhinagar, and other cities house world-class sports infrastructure and residential programs for national-level athletes.

records.name: National Institute of Sports Patiala
records.description: National Institute of Sports (NIS) Patiala is India's premier sports coaching and physical education institution, often called the 'Mecca of Indian sports.' Established in 1961, it offers diploma and certificate programs in coaching across 30+ sports disciplines and is affiliated with the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports. NIS Patiala has trained thousands of coaches and physical education teachers who serve at state and national levels across India.

records.name: Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education
records.description: Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE) in Gwalior is a deemed university and one of India's foremost institutions for physical education, sports science, and yoga education. It offers B.P.Ed., M.P.Ed., M.Sc. Sports Science, and Ph.D. programs, producing coaches, sports scientists, and physical education teachers for schools and sports bodies. LNIPE has campuses in Gwalior and Guwahati and is recognized by UGC and NCTE as a leading physical education institution.
